title: Cure-Cost Addition on Repeat-Violation Charges (Community Rules & Site Care Billing Note)
content:
A cure-cost addition is made to the repeat-violation charge of a notice under Community Rules & Site Care. It turns on the self-help charges on the plan record's statement dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date:

- two or more such self-help charges: an addition of $40.00;
- exactly one: an addition of $20.00;
- none: no addition.

The addition is a flat amount added to the charge of a notice that carries a schedule charge.

## Both sides of the thresholds

| Self-help charges dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date | Cure-cost addition |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | $20.00 |
| 2 | $40.00 |
| 3 or more | $40.00 |

## Hypothetical case

A plan record's statement carries self-help charges dated 3 months and 15 months before the handling date. Only the first falls within the 12 months, so the addition is $20.00.
